checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and pull all encounters in that window: ED visits, urgent care, hospital admissions, observation stays, and any readmissions, with diagnoses and discharge summaries.

Falls and near-falls since last review: count, circumstances, injuries, and whether any fall occurred while on antiplatelet therapy (clopidogrel) or beta-blocker; check orthostatic vitals and fall-risk screening documentation.

Medication reconciliation: the chart lists two simvastatin entries (10 mg started 2026-08-16 and 20 mg started 2020-07-11). Verify whether this is a dose change, a duplicate, or an error, confirm which strength the participant is actually taking, and confirm with prescriber and pharmacy fill history. Flag for the team; do not change therapy.

Confirm active status and last fill dates for metoprolol succinate, clopidogrel, and nitroglycerin spray; check for any new starts or stops in the window that are not on the active list, and note any nitroglycerin PRN use or chest-pain episodes reported.
Cardiac status (ischemic heart disease): review chest pain or angina episodes, dyspnea, edema, heart rate and blood pressure trends, and any cardiology visits or test results in the window.
Bleeding and antiplatelet safety: check for bleeding, bruising, GI symptoms, or anemia labs while on clopidogrel, and any new interacting medications.
Lipids and metabolic: review most recent lipid panel and statin tolerance (myalgias, adherence), and HbA1c or glucose results given prediabetes; note whether labs are due.
Weight and BMI trend (obesity, BMI 30+): compare current weight to prior review, note any unintended weight loss or gain, and check nutrition or dietitian referrals.

Oncology history (breast cancer, dx 1997): check for any surveillance imaging, mammography, oncology follow-up, or new symptoms such as bone pain, new lumps, or unexplained weight change; confirm survivorship follow-up is current.

Function, cognition, mood, and caregiver: review ADL/IADL changes, cognitive screen results, depression screening, social engagement and PACE center attendance/missed days, caregiver or living-situation changes, and any care-plan goals or assessments due in the window (e.g., annual reassessment timing relative to enrollment on 2025-04-05).
